description: The full list of lead fields a partner or an internal team can be given access to.

fields.label: Field Key
fields.description: The field's key, made of its section and field name, e.g. lab:hba1c.

fields.label: Section
fields.description: The part of the lead this field belongs to. Every row here is a lead field; an activity's questions are declared on its activity type instead.

fields.label: Fieldname
fields.description: The field's name on the record it is stored on.

fields.label: Is Multi Value
fields.description: This field accepts more than one value. Ticking it is the whole declaration - nothing else has to change.

fields.label: Filterable
fields.description: Allow reps to filter on this field in Smart Views.

fields.label: Sortable
fields.description: Allow reps to sort on this field in Smart Views.

fields.label: Surface
fields.description: The place the field appears - a column on the list, or the detail drawer only.

fields.label: Automation
fields.description: This section only records which changes are watched. What a campaign may read and write is decided by the contract, not here.

fields.label: Automation: Watchable
fields.description: A change to this field may start a campaign.

name: CRM Lead API Field
